description: Send the exact approved personal email from the authenticated business mailbox to 1–5 explicit recipients. This sends real email. First show the sender, recipient addresses, subject and full body; send only when the user explicitly authorizes that message. Selecting CRM leads or preparing meeting/booking links never authorizes sending. Use verified addresses from get_business_mail_recipients, never guess them. Requires a verified sending domain and applies the same suppression, tracking, sender name, rate and storage protections as the dashboard. Reuse the same requestId UUID for the same approved message. The response confirms provider submission, not delivery. If stored is false, report that the accepted message is missing its saved copy; do not resend. On an uncertain outcome, check Sent and clarify instead of retrying with a new ID. This is personal correspondence, not a newsletter or bulk broadcast.

approved.description: Only true after the user explicitly authorizes sending this exact message to these recipients.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this approved message. Reuse on retries; never change its content or recipients.

name: send_business_email
